text: dsh-wallpaper（DSH 网页插件）：为 DeepSeek Harness Web 界面添加可自定义的背景壁纸。它在 Settings → General 注册壁纸设置行，并在浏览器中应用背景图片和半透明界面样式。用户可以启用或关闭壁纸、选择内置折纸预设或填写图片路径/URL，并调节不透明度；样式适配浅色和深色主题。设置保存在当前浏览器的 localStorage 中；未发现必需的 API Key。

dsh-wallpaper (DSH web plugin): adds customizable backgrounds to DeepSeek Harness. In Settings → General, users can enable wallpaper, choose the Origami preset or enter an image path/URL, and adjust opacity. Styles adapt to light and dark themes; settings persist in browser localStorage.

Can I set a custom wallpaper and adjust how opaque the interface looks?
dsh-wallpaper 的功能「网页壁纸设置」：为 DSH 网页界面应用背景图片和半透明样式。用户可在 Settings → General 启用壁纸、选折纸预设或输入图片路径/URL，并调整不透明度；样式适配浅色和深色主题。

A **wallpaper / background plugin** for the [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) Web UI. Add a background image to the harness window that **auto-adapts to any screen**: the image is scaled with CSS `cover`, so it looks right on 1080p, 2K, 4K, or any display scaling, and the translucent surface colors follow light/dark theme automatically.

dsh-wallpaper README · dsh-wallpaper：Built-in preset enabled by default, custom image URL support, and an opacity slider — all from the **Settings → General → Wallpaper** row, with no Host restart and no plugin configuration.

dsh-wallpaper README · Features：- 🌄 **Built-in preset on by default** — the bundled "Origami" wallpaper (2560×1440) is applied immediately on a fresh profile
- 🖼️ **Custom image URLs** — paste any same-origin path (`/wallpapers/xxx.jpg`) or full `https://…` URL and hit Apply
- 🔄 **On/off switch** — one click to toggle the background
- 🎚️ **Opacity slider** — 30%–100% surface translucency, with separate values for light and dark themes
- 📐 **Any screen** — CSS `cover` scales and centers the image regardless of resolution, window size, or display scaling
- ⚡ **Pure client-side** — persists via `localStorage`, no Host schema registration, no `dsh web` restart, HMR-friendly

dsh-wallpaper README · Install：From this repository:

```sh
dsh plugin add https://github.com/fubao885522/dsh-wallpaper
```

From this checkout (development):

```sh
pnpm install
pnpm build
cd ..
dsh plugin add ./dsh-wallpaper

Remove:

```sh
dsh plugin remove dsh-wallpaper
```

dsh-wallpaper README · Usage：1. Open **Settings → General**.
2. Find the **Wallpaper** row (below Appearance).
3. Click **Origami** to apply the built-in preset, or paste an image URL and click **Apply**.
4. Use the toggle to turn the background on/off and the slider to adjust translucency.

The setting is stored per browser (`localStorage`), so it survives page reloads and HMR reloads.

dsh-wallpaper README · How it adapts to any machine：- The image is rendered with `background-size: cover; background-position: center`, so any resolution, aspect ratio, or DPI scaling is handled automatically.
- Surface colors are written as the same `--dsw-alias-*` tokens the harness frame uses, made translucent; `body[data-ds-dark-theme]` selects the dark palette values, so readability holds in both themes.
- Opacity is clamped to a readable range (0.3–1.0) and stored as a plain number.
